headline: DepEd Postpones Nationwide Active-Threat School Drills to September
seoTitle: DepEd Postpones Active-Threat School Drills to September | FMB News
seoDescription: DepEd postponed the August 25 nationwide active-threat school safety drill to September while it aligns the exercise with child-protection and psychosocial guidance.
deck: The education department moved the August 25 exercise to the first week of September and said the revised drill must be age-appropriate and trauma-informed.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Education postponed the Nationwide Simultaneous School Safety Drill for Active Attack Incidents that had been scheduled for Tuesday, August 25, 2026.
DepEd said the activity would instead be held during the first week of September. The agency had not announced a specific nationwide date as of Monday afternoon.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: DepEd said the additional time would allow the exercise to reflect recommendations from weather, disaster-preparedness, child-protection and psychosocial-support experts while safeguarding learners' physical and psychological well-being.

The Philippine Psychiatric Association and the Philippine Society for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry had urged the government to avoid hyper-realistic simulations. DepEd said the rescheduled drill would be age-appropriate and trauma-informed, focused on basic safety, communication and recovery, without graphic or theatrical scenarios that could cause unnecessary fear.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: School emergency preparedness must teach clear protective procedures without creating avoidable psychological harm. The postponement gives education and safety officials time to reconcile operational readiness with child-welfare guidance.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DepEd for the final nationwide date, detailed mechanics and guidance showing how schools should conduct active-threat exercises without graphic or hyper-realistic simulations.
